prompt:
Subject: White dress sleeping among the waves

Main Figure: A single young adult woman lying on her back with a white lace dress spread out on a sandy beach and turquoise blue shoreline viewed from directly above. Place the person vertically in the center, featuring the dress spreading large like wings to the sides and the white wave foam approaching from both sides.

Character/Expression: A slender oval face, bright smooth skin, natural thin eyebrows, clean nose, and pale rose-colored lips. A profile view facing the right of the screen with eyes closed, showing a peaceful expression as if sleeping quietly. Light natural makeup. Extremely long wavy dark brown hair spreads richly in a fan shape around the head, especially towards the top left of the screen, with the outlines of wet thin curls visible on the sand.

Clothing/Pose: Long dress of white lace and transparent tulle, three-dimensional flower embroidery, corset-like bodice, thin shoulder straps and short lace sleeves falling from the shoulders, heart-shaped neckline. Lies straight on her back on the sand with both arms quietly folded over the abdomen and both legs together extending towards the bottom of the screen. The long skirt and tulle spread out from the waist to the left and right like giant wings, with the hem mixing with the sea foam.

Background/Light: Dry smooth light brown sand in the top center, and transparent turquoise shallows in the bottom half. White mesh-like wave foam approaches diagonally from the left and right, forming a large V-shape or wing shape around the person and the dress. Bright and soft daylight from above illuminates the whole scene uniformly, with very thin 3D shadows on the person and the lace. Preserves the blue-green transparency of the water surface and details of white bubbles.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. A distant full-body composition from a bird's-eye view camera directly above. Place the head in the top half center and the toes in the bottom half center, fitting from the hair to the dress hem within most of the screen height. Spread the left and right lace and waves almost symmetrically, distributing sand at the top and blue sea at the bottom. Deep depth of field focused on the entire area of the person, lace, and wave foam.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic live-action photo expression with a sense of fantasy. Realistically depict skin, wet curly hair, delicate floral lace and transparent tulle, sand grains, thin water film, and large and small sea foam. Cleanly separate white, sand color, and vivid turquoise, maintaining the elegance where the dress and waves appear as wings.

Negative: Alteration of top-down composition, closed-eye profile, wing-shaped dress, or left-right wave placement.
